fields.System.Title: EPIC INB — Inbound Receiving
fields.System.Description:
Goal

Goods arriving at the dock become accurate, findable stock in storage locations, within four
hours of arrival.

Business value

Stock that has been received but not recorded cannot be sold. Every hour a pallet sits on the
dock unrecorded is an hour it is invisible to customers, and dock congestion slows every
subsequent delivery.

Receiving is also the system's first control point. An error caught here costs minutes. The
same error caught at picking costs a customer.

Scope

In. Advance shipping notices. Physical receiving against an ASN and blind. Quantity,
batch, expiry, and serial capture. Short and over receipt with tolerance and approval. Damage
handling. Quality holds. Putaway task generation, suggestion, override, and confirmation.
Receiving exception reporting.

Out. Purchasing decisions. Supplier contracts. Yard and dock scheduling.

Done when

  • A delivery can be received against an ASN, with batch and expiry captured.
  • A delivery can be received blind, with approval, landing in quarantine.
  • Short, over, and damaged receipts are recorded with reasons.
  • Confirming a receipt creates stock, movements, and putaway tasks in one transaction.
  • Confirming twice creates stock once.
  • Putaway suggests a legal location, allows an override with a reason, and moves the stock.
  • Stock stranded in receiving raises an alert.

Key risks

| Risk | Why it matters | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Partial commit on confirm | Double receipt, or goods with no putaway task | [doc 09 §2.1](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Duplicate confirm from a scanner retry | Stock counted twice | [doc 09 §3.2](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Wrong case quantity in master data | Systematic, invisible stock drift | [doc 03 §7.1](../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Two operators claiming one putaway task | Duplicate movement | [doc 09 §4.3](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Stock left in receiving over a weekend | Availability understated; orders fail | [doc 05 WF 3](../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Suggested location full on arrival | Operator stuck; override without validation | [doc 05 WF 3](../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
